name: antigravity
description:
Signing up for classes for the next semester is always a handful. Each major has its own major-specific requirements in addition to general education courses within the college. Keeping track of prerequisites for each class makes planning for the next few semesters difficult. If you add a minor or another major, it becomes even more complicated to keep track of overlapping classes and classes that you need to do for each specific major.

While the current degree audit is a very good tool to keep track of requirements for each major, it does not provide a holistic perspective on all the classes you need to take. The degree audit provides information for each major separately, not taking into account classes from other majors or minors that a student is taking. This makes the degree audit inconvenient.
